name: smwgraphics-parodius-non-sense-fantasy-public-bath-octo-s-bad-hair-day
title: Parodius: Non-Sense Fantasy - Public Bath (Octo's Bad Hair Day)
description:
A very parodius-esque background, found in Parodius Da! for the SNES. It's found in the room where the player fights a giant octopus that attacks by rubbing his head, that's covered in shampoo. Originally planned to be used in Mutsu Mountainroad, in the Hot Springs area. Could be used for some kinda of temple level. Background can be expanded to cover all the screen.

Credit would be great but is optional.
